responsibility: Provides the AVX-512 FP16 + AVX-512VL intrinsic layer for 128-bit and 256-bit half-precision vector operations. It focuses on VL-sized casts, arithmetic, masking, reductions, permutations, conjugation, and complex-half helper intrinsics for __m128h and __m256h, complementing avx512fp16intrin.h by exposing the non-512-bit forms of the FP16 ISA subset.
